column1: # COVERAGE.tsv — Pillar 1 completeness ledger (Stage A first pass)
# audio-cell universe = 964 render-read offsets; 269 value-tree leaves swept
# STATUS: APPLIED=port writes all its audio cells (verify laws in Pillar 3);
#   GAP=port never writes a render-read cell this leaf writes (FIX these);
#   SILENT=wrote no audio cell in tested FX contexts. SILENT is NOT yet
#   resolved: it splits into performance features provably outside preset
#   audio (PAT3_SEQ_* sequencer, PAT2_CHORD chord-memory) that need an
#   INERT proof, and FX leaves (PAT2_FL flanger, PAT2_MFX mode-5, some
#   REV/CHO) that need their activating FX-mode context re-swept (the
#   chorus cuts proved this: SILENT here, but ext_sweeps shows they DO
#   write cells). Ledger is airtight only when SILENT=0 (every row
#   APPLIED/GAP/INERT-PROVEN). This first pass delivers the GAP LIST.
# TWO-MECHANISM ARCHITECTURE (proven this session): patch params reach the
#   engine two ways — (1) the value-tree ENGINE dispatch (0x3B9A30), which
#   writes cells our oracle observes; (2) the CONTROLLER path (record byte
#   -> cell) whose engine dispatch is a NO-OP (proven: F ENV VARIATION and
#   all extended fine-FX write nothing via dispatch even after full block
#   pre-activation, leaf_cellmap_activated.py). Classification therefore
#   uses TWO applied-signals: LOAD_LEAVES membership (the oracle's own
#   recall set, render-A/B-proven port==oracle) AND port_writeset. A leaf
#   in neither, that an in-scope JUNO-60 effect owns, is a GAP; SYSTEM-8
#   params (OSC2, mod matrix, the PROGRAMMABLE PAT2_MFX — distinct from
#   EFFECT TYPE 5's fixed chorus that effect_modes.c handles) + GUI + seq
#   are INERT (out of JUNO-60 scope, GOAL.md).
# REMAINING HONESTY CAVEATS: (a) the PAT2_MFX=SYSTEM-8 scope call is the one
#   judgment the engine oracle can't fully self-verify -> confirm via the
#   controller path (Pillar 2); (b) the EFFECT/DELAY TYPE router GAP rows
#   carry a few residual mode-5/chorus setup cells (sweep crosses modes);
#   (c) per-leaf VALUE-law correctness of APPLIED rows is Pillar 3, not this
#   ledger. The 26-GAP worklist (delay/chorus/flanger/reverb fine params) is
#   the FX-completeness fix #116/#124 and is solid.
